subject: Overgrowth and Rodent Control Ordinances
overview: The committee reviewed a new ordinance for property overgrowth and updates to existing rodent control regulations to enhance public health enforcement. The body discussed legal redlines regarding fine collection and regulatory language before keeping both matters in committee for further revision.

items.title: Overgrowth and Rodent Control Ordinances
items.summary: Councillor Collins introduced a new overgrowth ordinance and updates to rodent control regulations aimed at addressing public health hazards and funding mitigation through collected fines.

items.title: Solicitor Review and Regulatory Language
items.summary: The committee reviewed legal feedback suggesting that specific requirements for rodent mitigation should reside in Board of Health regulations rather than the municipal code to allow for easier updates.

items.title: DPW Enforcement Coordination
items.summary: DPW Commissioner McGivern requested a review to avoid duplicating existing sidewalk obstruction enforcement, while sanitarians suggested aligning stagnant water definitions with the state sanitary code.

items.title: Committee Action
items.summary: The committee voted to keep both matters in committee so the sponsor could incorporate technical tweaks and coordinate with department heads on revised drafts. Referred to committee.
